Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing minimum notification requirements for property and casualty insurance policy changes.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to minimum notification requirements for propertyand casualty insurance policy changes; adding a new section to chapter48.22 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 48.27 RCW; and providing aneffective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.22 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) All insurers doing business in this state shall provide anotice of policy change to each producer receiving an insurance policyfrom the insurer under the following circumstances: (a) The insurance policy covers personal lines or business lines ofcasualty insurance, not including medical, workers' compensation,employers' liability, nuclear liability, or disability insurance; and (b) The insurance policy contains a material change from either thelast previous standard insurance policy that the insurer provided tothe producer for sale to the public or a material change from thecoverage last previously provided under a policy being renewed. (2) The notice of policy change must include the change or changes p. 1 SB 6568in coverage, described in plain language on a separate page of paperprefacing the changed policy or policy being renewed. (3) Each producer shall communicate the contents of the notice ofpolicy change to the consumer prior to the consumer's acceptance of thepolicy or policy being renewed. (4) Any policy change not made in compliance with this section isnot effective and is unenforceable.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.27 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) All insurers doing business in this state shall provide anotice of policy change to each producer receiving an insurance policyfrom the insurer under the following circumstances: (a) The insurance policy covers personal lines or business lines ofproperty insurance; and (b) The insurance policy contains a material change from either thelast previous standard insurance policy that the insurer provided tothe producer for sale to the public or a material change from thecoverage last previously provided under a policy being renewed. (2) The notice of policy change must include the change or changesin coverage, described in plain language on a separate page of paperprefacing the changed standard policy or policy being renewed. (3) Each producer shall communicate the contents of the notice ofpolicy change to the purchaser prior to the purchaser's acceptance ofthe policy or policy being renewed. (4) Any policy change not made in compliance with this section isnot effective and is unenforceable.
This act takes effect July 1, 2011, andapplies to insurance policies covered by this act that are issued orrenewed on or after July 1, 2011.
